name: kubernetes-manager
description: Codex workflow support for integrating projects with Kubernetes and Docker Desktop Kubernetes.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate projects with Kubernetes and local Docker Desktop clusters.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex skill and helper scripts for assessing a project, generating Kubernetes manifests, checking Docker Desktop Kubernetes, validating resources, and applying workloads through kubectl.
defaultPrompt: Use Kubernetes Manager to integrate this project with Kubernetes.
Check whether Docker Desktop Kubernetes is ready for local development.
Generate Kubernetes manifests for this service and validate them.
